verdict.rationale: NotebookLM ingests many papers, answers grounded questions with citations, lets you scope chat to selected sources, supports custom report prompts, and saves tabular responses as notes that export to Google Sheets. Together these approximate an extraction pass across papers, and one user calls it useful for structured research workflows. There is no dedicated screening or extraction workflow, so consistent criteria depend on the user repeating prompts by hand. Missing for 10: inclusion/exclusion screening features, reusable per-paper extraction templates or schemas, a structured per-paper extraction table, batch application of consistent criteria at scale, and independent hands-on evidence of systematic-review use.
